claim: Microchip derived 47% of its fiscal 2026 net sales through distributors, up from 45% in fiscal 2025.
evidence: "In fiscal 2026, we derived 47% of our net sales through distributors compared to 53% of our net sales from customers serviced directly by us. In fiscal 2025, we derived 45% of our net sales through distributors..." (FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1, Sales and Distribution)
notes: Newer fiscal year for CLM-0274 (which remains correct for FY2025).

claim: Gartner's February 2025 release gives 2023 worldwide semiconductor revenue of US$529.964 billion, revising its preliminary estimate of US$533.0 billion.
evidence: Table 1 (2024 release): "Total Market | 625,971 | 100.0 | 529,964 | 18.1" (2023 Revenue column, millions of USD; Source: Gartner (February 2025)). Preliminary (Jan 2024): "Total Market 533.025 ... -11.1" (Table 1).

metric.name: Worldwide semiconductor revenue
metric.methodology: Gartner vendor revenue analysis; 2023 comparison column of the Feb 2025 top-10 table

notes: The revised 2023 growth rate is not given in the Feb 2025 release; Gartner's final 2023 market share abstract (not openable, Cloudflare) reportedly gives -11.7%. Do not combine the revised level with the preliminary -11.1%.

claim: Avnet's fiscal 2026 (year ended 27 June 2026) gross profit was US$2,881.9 million.

metric.name: Gross profit
metric.methodology: XBRL-tagged value from audited 10-K financial statements

notes: With FY2026 sales of US$27,632.7m (XBRL Revenue concept, same accession; also SRC-0215 selected financial data) this implies a gross margin of about 10.4%, versus 10.7% in FY2025 (CLM-0272). Newer period for CLM-0272.
